controls.attributes:
label="Academic year"
              name="academicYear"
              value={student?.academicYear ?? prefs.academicYear}
              hint="Format: 2026-2027"

name="status"
          label="Status"
          choices={options([
            "Not Yet Placed",
            "Applying",
            "Awaiting Placement",
            "Ongoing",
            "Completed",
            "Terminated",
          ])}

name="sort"
          label="Sort by"
          choices={[
            { value: "name", label: "Student Name" },
            { value: "id", label: "Student ID" },
            { value: "hours", label: "Rendered Hours" },
          ]}

label="Status"
              name="status"
              required={false}
              options={options([
                "Not Yet Placed",
                "Applying",
                "Awaiting Placement",
                "Ongoing",
                "Completed",
                "Terminated",
                "Pending",
                "Active",
                "Expiring Soon",
                "Expired",
                "Pending Approval",
                "Approved",
                "Closed",
                "Accepted",
                "Rejected",
                "Submitted",
              ])}
              hint="Choose a status applicable to the selected report; an incompatible status returns an empty result."

label="Work date"
              name="workDate"
              type="date"
              max={new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}

name="sort"
          label="Sort dates"
          choices={[
            { value: "start-newest", label: "Start newest" },
            { value: "start-oldest", label: "Start oldest" },
            { value: "end-newest", label: "End latest" },
            { value: "end-oldest", label: "End earliest" },
          ]}

label="MOA start date"
              name="moaStart"
              type="date"
              value={company?.moaStart}

label="MOA end date"
              name="moaEnd"
              type="date"
              value={company?.moaEnd}

name="evaluator"
          label="Assigned evaluator"
          choices={db.accounts
            .filter((a) =>
              ["Faculty Adviser", "Company Supervisor"].includes(a.role),
            )
            .map((a) => ({ value: a.id, label: a.name }))}

note: Source inventory aids inspection; hashes and JSX presence alone do not prove behavior. See executed browser assertions and route/control matrix.
